name: hrm-backend
description: HRM Enterprise Core Server — REST + SOAP payroll gateway (On-Premises SOA)

scripts.install:all: for dir in api-gateway identity-service organization-service work-service payroll-service integration-service; do (echo "\n=== Installing $dir ===" && cd $dir && npm install); done
scripts.prisma:generate: for dir in identity-service organization-service work-service payroll-service integration-service; do (echo "\n=== Prisma generate $dir ===" && cd $dir && npx prisma generate); done
scripts.prisma:push: for dir in identity-service organization-service work-service payroll-service integration-service; do (echo "\n=== Prisma db push $dir ===" && cd $dir && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss); done
scripts.prisma:seed: echo "\n=== Seeding DB ===" && (cd identity-service && node prisma/seed.js) && (cd integration-service && node prisma/seed.js)
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run prisma:seed
